Compatible singleton resident RHF response borrows existing full J/K capacity even when occupied factors are unavailable; this dense reuse requires no factor reservation or new allocation. Occupied response additionally requires the shared twofold-work-reduction policy and actual projection capacity; immutable raw values are reused only with matching source identity. Explicit incompatible schedules/probes retain panel execution; VIBEQC_DF_RESPONSE_STORAGE=panel preserves the prior route and jk-scratch opts eligible shapes into the checked borrow. Providers without GEAM (including CuMetal) reuse the existing J/K gather for raw layout conversion; NVIDIA retains GEAM through a compile-time capability check. Automatic occupied-space response shares SCF/seed/final exchange workload and capacity admission, without an AO/rank endpoint, equal-basis or GPU-name whitelist. Automatic factor reservation is method/rank-aware and declines optional storage when it would force a dense resident plan into streaming; UHF, unknown and unprofitable ranks retain dense accounting. Execution additionally requires a validated method-authorized final-state token with exact canonical density and matching device factor generations. It forms occupied projections and at most 64 auxiliary AO pseudo-density slices in borrowed J/K storage; unsupported or corrected states retain dense response. Explicit occupied response also validates both UHF spins, including rank-zero beta. Derivative pair auto selection folds dense shell pairs in the promoted 192--384 regime and emits folded packed AO pairs in the qualified 768 occupied domain. Packed production uses bounded 256-row rectangular BLAS blocks and at most 64 auxiliary AOs, aligned to shell boundaries. Explicit full/symmetric/packed pair and 64/128/256/384 block controls retain independent diagnostics; generated derivative mathematics is unchanged.
